symptom: TPC-H query misses Memoize after a cardinality estimate of one propagates through nested loops
checkpoint: Compare the first estimate divergence and semantically equivalent subquery forms before changing costs

symptom: Workload loses performance after upgrading from PostgreSQL 12.15 to 17.2
checkpoint: Compare equivalent plans, indexes, settings and statistics on the same data

symptom: SQL function query locks all partitions although its displayed plan reads one partition
checkpoint: Distinguish plan-time pruning, execution-time pruning and locks acquired during planning

symptom: A view query becomes slow when an implicit cast prevents the expected access path
checkpoint: Inspect parameter types, casts, operator classes and the resulting index conditions

symptom: PostgreSQL 17 chooses a multicolumn index and runs slower than comparable PostgreSQL 15 and 16 plans
checkpoint: Compare the chosen index, true index quals, filter quals and per-loop timing

symptom: Versions 17 and 18 can discard a redundant NOT NULL qual before matching a partial-index predicate
checkpoint: Compare normalized query predicates with the exact partial-index predicate and server version

symptom: Expression-index statistics exist but the planner estimates one third of the table and may select a sequential scan
checkpoint: Inspect expression identity, Boolean selectivity and index statistics rather than assuming they apply

symptom: Row comparison over a multicolumn B-tree scans farther than expected on older versions
checkpoint: Separate equality prefixes from range conditions and compare index conditions across versions

symptom: Unique keys fully covered by predicates still produce a questionable cardinality estimate
checkpoint: Verify uniqueness scope, null semantics and whether all key columns are constrained

symptom: Planner fails to choose a partial index after simplifying a spurious NOT NULL condition
checkpoint: Record affected versions; do not work around it by globally disabling sequential scans

symptom: Random index access underuses available I/O concurrency
checkpoint: Inspect access method, correlation, cache state and version before attributing latency to storage

symptom: array_agg with HashAggregate shows a significant PostgreSQL 17 performance issue
checkpoint: Inspect group count, transition-state size, batches, peak memory and temp I/O
